ifDeleted.summary: Good Instinct is the hinge of the SJ and Brendan story. On stage, SJ dismisses Claude, Brendan quietly lets Claude find the bug, feeds SJ the answer, and SJ praises his instinct; Brendan then hides it. It also holds one of the three talking-over-Kristina standups. s07 can report the facts afterwards, but the audience would only hear about the deception secondhand and never see SJ's delight, which is what every later Brendan and SJ beat leans on.
